'''------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Description: set the initial values for non-persistent fields.
Modification History:
Date            Version                      Author                        Comment
===================================================================================================
2024-04-23      1.0                         IBM/Samer Al Fakih           Inital version 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------'''
import java.util.Hashtable;
from psdi.util.logging import MXLoggerFactory
from psdi.mbo import MboConstants

logger = MXLoggerFactory.getLogger("maximo.script")
logger.info(" Start IBMCFGTRCKINIT script \n")


# Initialize an empty hash table
Hashtable = {}
if interactive==True:
    # Populate the hash table with the artifactname attribute name and artifacttype values
    for artifactKeyAttributes in [("AUTOSCRIPT", ["AUTOSCRIPT"]),
                ("SIGOPTION", ["OPTIONNAME","APP"]),
                ("ATTRIBUTE", ["ATTRIBUTENAME","OBJECTNAME"]),
                ("LOOKUPMAP", ["ATTRIBUTENAME","OBJECTNAME"]),
                ("DOMAIN", ["DOMAIN"]),
                ("RELATIONSHIP", ["RELATIONSHIP","OBJECTNAME"]),
                ("OBJECT", ["OBJECTNAME"]),
                ("ACTION", ["ACTION"]),
                ("ACTIONGRP", ["ACTIONGRP"]),
                ("CONDITION", ["CONDITION"]),
                ("APP", ["APP"]),
                ("MENU", ["APP","OPTIONNAME","MENUTYPE"]),
                ("APPAUTH", ["GROUPNAME","APP"]),
                ("INTOBJECT", ["INTOBJECTNAME"]),
                ("ENDPOINT", ["ENDPOINT"]),
                ("COMTEMP", ["COMTEMP"]),
                ("IFACEIN", ["IFACEIN"]),
                ("IFACEOUT", ["IFACEOUT"]),
                ("ESCALATION", ["ESCALATION"]),
                ("WORKFLOW", ["WORKFLOW","WFREVISION"]),
                ("MESSAGE", ["MSGKEY","MSGGROUP"]),
                ("INTOBJECT", ["INTOBJECTNAME"]),
                ("SC", ["SCNAME"]),
                ("SYSPROP", ["PROPNAME"]),
                ("INDEX", ["INDEX","OBJECTNAME"]),
                ("XML", ["APP"]),
                ("QUERY", ["QUERY","APP"]),
                ("REPORT", ["REPORT","APP"]),
                ("SECGROUP", ["GROUPNAME"]),
                ("CRONTASK", ["CRONTASK"]),
                ("ROLE", ["ROLE"]),
                ("ORG", ["ORGID"]),
                ("CALENDAR", ["CALNUM","ORGID"]),
                ("MAXVARS", ["VARNAME","ORGID"]),
                ("EXTSYSTEM", ["EXTSYSTEM"])]:
        Hashtable[artifactKeyAttributes[0]] = artifactKeyAttributes[1]


    # Function to get the artifactname for a given artifacttype
    def get_artifactname(artifacttype):
        return Hashtable.get(artifacttype)
        
    # Call the function to get the artifactname for a given artifacttype
    artifacttype = mbo.getString("artifacttype")
    logger.info(artifacttype +"  \n")

    artifact = get_artifactname(artifacttype)

    if artifact is not None:
        artifactname=mbo.getString("artifactname")
        logger.info(artifactname +"  \n")
        mbo.setValue(artifact[0],artifactname,MboConstants.NOACTION|MboConstants.NOVALIDATION)

        if artifact and len (artifact)==2:
            artifactsecondkey=mbo.getString("artifactsecondkey")
            mbo.setValue(artifact[1],artifactsecondkey,MboConstants.NOACTION|MboConstants.NOVALIDATION)
        elif len (artifact)==3:
            artifactsecondkey=mbo.getString("artifactsecondkey")
            mbo.setValue(artifact[1],artifactsecondkey,MboConstants.NOACTION|MboConstants.NOVALIDATION)
            artifactThirdkey=mbo.getString("artifactthirdkey")
            mbo.setValue(artifact[2],artifactThirdkey,MboConstants.NOACTION|MboConstants.NOVALIDATION)


        mbo.setFieldFlag(artifact[0],MboConstants.READONLY, True)
        mbo.setFieldFlag("artifacttype",MboConstants.READONLY, True)
        
    status = mbo.getString("status")
    if status=='CLOSE':
        mbo.setFlag(MboConstants.READONLY, True)

logger.info(" End IBMCFGTRCKINIT script \n")
